tools.name: bikerlink_get_place
tools.description: Get public information including image_url and hub_graphic_url for one active Punto Biker or Smart Station by code, e.g. PB-00002 or SS-00002. When present, verified_data contains published BikerLink services, prices, offers and the verification date. ONLY human_verified:true with verification_label

tools.name: bikerlink_photo_pages
tools.description: Find public PhotoPass/photo gallery links associated with active Punti Biker. Includes the public PB image_url and hub_graphic_url; no individual photos, photo availability dates, galleries or purchases are indexed here.

tools.name: bikerlink_search_verified_services
tools.description: Search published BikerLink REAL services and offers from active PB and SS locations, with controlled Italian, English, German and Spanish keyword variants for motorcycle travel. This is keyword/concept matching, not full natural-language AI interpretation. Only records explicitly marked human_verifi
